method: Prepare one distinct small-adjustment construction for the57 previously fixed originals. Each retains its original shape, orientation, sheet and copy, with each axis translation bounded to+/-0.05mm on a0.0001mm grid. Intersect those bounds with rational inward stock constraints requiring0.0125mm extra margin. For every same-sheet polygon pair within0.36mm, examine every boundary segment pair within0.36mm. The closest-point direction proposes a fixed separating normal; round that normal to integer coefficients and compute exact rational full-segment projection gaps, using an integer ceiling of its norm for a conservative0.2125mm target. Far original features are not assumed safe without the final full-geometry check. These local projection constraints are a proposal mechanism; only independent reconstruction of every moved original pair and stock edge can qualify the adjusted baseline geometry. No counts or native guards are reduced. No solver call in preparation.
